title: LC-MS feature detection from mzML data
research_question: How to detect features in LC-MS data?
finding: MZmine3 detects 85% of expected features on benchmark dataset.
task_description: Run MZmine3 feature detection on provided mzML file and export feature table.
workflow_description: 1. Open mzML in MZmine3. 2. Run ADAP chromatogram builder. 3. Export feature table.
